new_rule_properties: No company name/type/page ID or known answer literal in production boundary predicates.
No Japanese character-count, line-count, fixed-point gap, em-ratio or fixed number-of-related-statements cap in the new boundary module.
Source font/size identities are read from every emitted native Word; no font-name or inferred boldness whitelist. Metadata stays attached to the same source occurrence through canonical sorting.
Formal announcement suffixes, financial-announcement category, era/date syntax and role prefixes are domain vocabulary. These are not organization identities.
Same heading evidence must be separated from its own date style; dates/signatures cannot be borrowed past another semantic heading, from quoted content or from non-body regions.

Whole closed frames require finite geometry, unique source ownership, complete Word/whole-table containment and contiguous source lines. A common procedure frame retains all related financial statements.
An arbitrary title can qualify in a complete independent frame with its own different date style and signature. No announcement-title keyword is required for this framed route.
Cross-page open quote scope abstains from new cuts on the continuation page, resumes on later pages after matching closure.
Every original Article endpoint survives; only new splits are made, with exact source-offset mapping rather than text search for repeated titles.
New Doc partitions retain all original Run text bytes, styles and whole tables, including LF/spaces at boundaries.
counterexamples_and_invariances: Arbitrary company values and arbitrary framed titles
Positive scaling and negative coordinate translation
Invalid/partial dates, positional and Kanji numbers, padded date presentation
Quoted headings/dates/signatures within and across pages
Wrong source text, repeated Word IDs, nonfinite geometry
Related financial children and unresolved procedure parents
Adjacent missing-style/body-style semantic headings still fence evidence
Signatureless independent financial frame with own date and whole table
Undated or unsigned unclassified table frame does not qualify
Five real PDF full membership controls and Word emission reversal
not_proven: All existing parser rules are general: older fixed guards still need audit.
Source font identity differences always imply a visual boldness difference.
Bounding rectangles or native paths are universal visible-ink/logical ownership certificates.
Complete organization/issuer field recognition, including quoted/counterparty identities.
Every new Article is already a complete original announcement: some unsupported following units remain joined.
Every legal date/qualifier/title/role syntax or every page orientation is supported.
